edits.corpus_citation: 5e original (apps/assay/vendor/run_balance/base_spells_5e/gen_homebrew.json, 'Monstrous Copy: Shell'): single trigger names 3 distinct categories ('magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll'); store's translation of 'magic missile' collapsed to the same wording as its own third clause ('a ranged spell attack roll targets you' == 'targeted by a spell that requires a ranged attack roll'), duplicating one condition instead of stating two.
edits.notes: Merged the duplicate 1st/3rd clauses into the two genuinely distinct triggers per CARDS.md L549 FIX disposition. Frequency line and the AC/resistance addition (both CARD/held per L548 and L550) left untouched.

edits.before_quote: The vines extend and retract as you move, always anchoring to the nearest surface. For the duration,
edits.after_quote: The vines extend and retract as you move, always anchoring to the nearest surface. If a vine is destroyed, it's immediately replaced. For the duration,
edits.corpus_citation: 5e original: 'if any of the vines are destroyed they are immediately replaced with more vines' — dropped from the store version entirely.
edits.notes: Restored the dropped durability clause per CARDS.md L776 FIX disposition, direct port translated to the store's existing plain register. Left the separate 'natural expiration landing' T6 flag untouched (CARD, not FIX, not in this assignment).

edits.before_quote: If you are falling when you cast this spell (using a reaction or if you lose consciousness), the vines catch you, negating all falling damage.
edits.after_quote: If you are falling when you cast this spell (using a reaction), the vines catch you, negating all falling damage.
edits.notes: Struck the 'or if you lose consciousness' arm per CARDS.md L775 (T1 CARD, lean strike): no PF2e-legal mechanism lets an unconscious creature cast a reaction spell, so as written that arm was mechanically meaningless. Kept the '(using a reaction)' arm per the assignment's explicit instruction to keep it if it does real work; flagging below that this spell's own system.time.value is '2' (a two-action cast), not a reaction, so the surviving 'using a reaction' arm's fit with this spell's own casting-time field is itself unclear — left untouched since only the unconsciousness arm was in scope, but noting the residual ambiguity for the next reviewer rather than freelancing further.

edits.before_quote: You tear a rift in linear time and shape it into a translucent, rippling wall of temporal energy at a point within range. The wall is intangible;
edits.after_quote: You tear a rift in linear time and shape it into a translucent, rippling wall of temporal energy at a point within range, forming either a straight wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is intangible;
edits.corpus_citation: 5e original: 'You can make a straight wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a circular wall up to 20 feet high, 1 foot thick, and forming a closed circle 20 feet in diameter.' Also matches the file's own adapterWarnings fossil text verbatim ('a straight wall up to 60 feet long and 20 feet high, or a ring 20 feet in diameter and 20 feet high, 1 foot thick'). Phrasing idiom ('either a straight ... or a ... ring, with the same height') mirrors the store's own wall-of-fire.json prose exactly ('either a 5-foot-thick wall of flame in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high, or a 5-foot-thick, 10-foot-radius ring of flame with the same height').
edits.notes: STRUCTURAL FIELD FINDING: verified system.area against all 14 official wall-* spells in apps/codex/data/snapshots/foundry/pf2e-8.3.0/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/ (wall-of-stone, wall-of-fire, wall-of-ice, wall-of-force, wall-of-metal, wall-of-flesh, wall-of-mirrors, wall-of-shadow, wall-of-thorns, wall-of-virtue, wall-of-water, wall-of-wind, wall-of-radiance, wall-of-shrubs) — every single one carries system.area:null and system.target.value:"", with wall dimensions expressed ONLY in prose, never structurally. This contradicts the assignment's premise that official wall spells structure system.area for dimensions. The coherent action mirroring the verified official convention is: leave system.area as null (unchanged, already null) and restore the dimensions in prose only, which is what this edit does. Did not touch the crossing-mechanic design or the Heightened(7th) block (both held cards per CARDS.md L872-873).

edits.before_quote: Time thickens around a mighty creature, dragging at its limbs and dulling the edge of its greatness. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.
edits.after_quote: You slow down the flow of time around a mighty creature. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.
edits.corpus_citation: 5e original: 'You slow down the flow of time around a legendary creature, robbing it of the speed necessary to perform legendary actions.' Store already uses 'mighty creature' as its PF2e-native translation of 'legendary creature' (kept, matches the settled mythic-vs-legendary-actions redesign) — only the ornate opening clause was replaced with the plain register.
edits.notes: Per CARDS.md L483/L486 (T6, low-stakes CARD) — mythic-redesign mechanics (untouched) are a separate, already-settled question; this edit is pure register restoration.

edits.notes: Per CARDS.md L509/L512 (T6 CARD). Left the rest of the description (the 'For the duration, each target can understand...' sentence and the speak-clause) untouched — not flagged in the dossier and outside this row's scope.
